Senior Backend Engineer — Platform & Payments

We are hiring a Senior Backend Engineer to build high-throughput payment APIs and event-driven microservices.

Requirements:
- 5+ years backend development in Go and/or Python
- PostgreSQL, Redis, Kafka, Kubernetes on AWS or GCP
- Experience with SEPA/instant payments, idempotency, and observability (OpenTelemetry)
- Led reliability or performance initiatives (latency, incident reduction)
- Mentoring engineers and writing RFCs/standards

Nice to have: Terraform, GitHub Actions, fintech compliance (DORA), zero-downtime migrations.
